mostWorthwhile.text: Following existing coat variation through natural selection was most worthwhile: it explained how a population changes over generations rather than acquiring traits because it needs them.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating the oasis was the least engaging moment: it was the only offered combination and initially had no explanation.

surprise.text: The oasis became a refuge with a spring, food and cover, making the migration route more concrete than its initial creation suggested.

arbitrary.text: Combining the sheltered oasis with cold-adapted populations felt somewhat abstract, though the result clarified that it represented two different survival paths.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose another chapter: the linked explanations of selection, migration and glacial change made the short sequence worthwhile, even if some choices were predictable.
